title: Trailside Nature Museum
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: The Trailside Museum provides funding for many ongoing research projects in Ward Pound Ridge Reservation, including our Flora Report. Its objective is to preserve a specimen of every vascular plant species growing spontaneously in the park and to identify and document the ecological communities, prioritizing those of conservation concern.
